record.title: Exceptional extended Sukkot restriction on West Bank and Gaza crossings, October 2017
record.scope: Palestinian movement through Israeli-controlled crossings of disputed/de facto boundaries
record.crossings: West Bank crossings and Gaza Erez; cargo conditions differed
record.direction: Mainly movement out of West Bank/Gaza; category-specific operation
record.movement: Palestinians otherwise eligible to cross; categories and destinations differed
record.exceptions: Approved humanitarian, medical and exceptional cases; some earlier passenger and cargo movement is recorded.
record.enforcement: Military order plus independent Gaza crossing monitoring.
record.relationship: Exceptional extension, not routine daily hours; international status is not inferred from inclusion.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no current closure status inferred.
record.official_rationale: Security assessment after the Har Adar attack; extended holiday closure.
record.context: The announced eleven-day measure exceeded the usual holiday interruption and is included as an exceptional restriction.
record.uncertainty: Erez business passage occurred October 8–10 during the extended holiday restriction, then resumed October 15 after another interruption. October 15 is not the first partial reopening. Actual restoration across the whole West Bank is unestablished; medical, other passenger and cargo movements followed separate schedules.
